entities.name: PMID:25098177
observations: Retrospective study compared summer and winter serum KL-6 in IPF, NSIP, collagen-vascular ILD, house-related HP, bird-related HP, and CPFE.
Bird-related HP had higher winter KL-6 and house-related HP had higher summer KL-6; seasonal KL-6 variation was greater in HP than comparator ILDs.
Seasonal variation was greater in acute than chronic HP; exact group-wise effect sizes were not available in the retrieved text.

entities.name: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis
observations: In the direct 2014 comparator study, house-related and bird-related HP showed greater seasonal serum KL-6 variation than other comparator interstitial lung diseases.
Seasonal direction differed by exposure context: bird-related HP increased in winter, whereas house-related HP increased in summer.

entities.name: PMID:40992120
observations: A retrospective longitudinal cohort of 910 ILD patients identified four annual KL-6 patterns: minimal change, summer decrease, autumn increase, and winter increase.
IPF, nonfibrotic HP, and fibrotic HP were associated with specific seasonal patterns, but the abstract did not establish greater continuous variation amplitude for HP than IPF.

observations: Human study specifically examined seasonal serum KL-6 and SP-D variation in bird-related HP, but retrieved sources lacked extractable numerical results and statistics.
